about: The always-on week run: the frozen analysis (scripts/week-analysis.py) and the audits (week-part-ran.py, week-gbrain-misses.py, week-qm-misses.py), run on the merged results directory with every trial folder.

not_rebuilt.what: The merged trial list and per-shard records (results/merged/, results/shards/)
not_rebuilt.reason: They were written by the run itself; verify uses them as this run's receipts.

not_rebuilt.what: The frozen analysis and audits (results/analysis/analysis.json, analysis.md, part-ran.json, gbrain-misses.json, qm-misses.json) and every number in report.md
not_rebuilt.reason: The scripts read each trial's folder (turn transcripts, event logs, QM database dumps, harness ready records), which stay in the private raw archive raw-always-on-week-2026-11 (manifest sha256 e645e1026eaf4ae9ea1041a72b6c5b6ff45ed8f62527d623975063cdc89d4a1a), not in the repository. reproduce.md gives the commands.

not_rebuilt.what: The summarize-run and compare-run tables (results/analysis/summarize-run.md, compare-run.md)
not_rebuilt.reason: Both scripts read the trial folders as well, and the committed summarize-run.md drops two internal labels from its section titles. Its QM termination tally (completed 39, harness_error 1), like the one in analysis.json, and its QM relay ended-early count (1) were corrected by hand, as was that trial's row in analysis.json on 2026-11-24 for wk-05 r3, which trials.jsonl records as completed (deviations.md).
